description: This file defines the PHP client class for interacting with the AWS IoT Jobs Data Plane service, including method annotations for various synchronous and asynchronous operations.

classes.name: IoTJobsDataPlaneClient
classes.description: A client class for the AWS IoT Jobs Data Plane service, extending the base AwsClient class with specific methods for the service.

methods.name: describeJobExecution
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific job execution.

methods.name: describeJobExecutionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details about a specific job execution.

methods.name: getPendingJobExecutions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of pending job executions.

methods.name: getPendingJobExecutionsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of pending job executions.

methods.name: startCommandExecutionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously starts execution of a command.

methods.name: startNextPendingJobExecution
methods.description: Starts the next pending job execution.

methods.name: startNextPendingJobExecutionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously starts the next pending job execution.

methods.name: updateJobExecutionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates a specific job execution.
